title: How to Crochet a Circle Granny Square
author: Breann (Hooked on Homemade Happiness)
notes: Round 1 text omits the beginning ch 3 (pattern note says ch 3 counts as dc; DSL includes it). Round 5: repeat taken as ending with 10 dc so the stated 64 dc holds. pattern.dsl left empty: the checker cannot parse the stated count '48 crochet stitches' in Round 4 (the DSL gives 48 sts). Draft DSL (all other rounds ok): start: mr | R1: 3ch=dc 11dc@ring ss@top # the beginning ch 3 is implied by the pattern note | R2: 3ch=dc dc@same [2dc@st]x11 ss@top | R3: 3ch=dc 2dc@st [dc 2dc@st]x11 ss@top | R4: 3ch=dc {dc 2ch 2dc}@same dc 2hdc 2sc 2hdc dc [{2dc 2ch 2dc}@st dc 2hdc 2sc 2hdc dc]x3 ss@top | R5: 3ch=dc dc [{2dc 2ch 2dc}@sp 12dc]x3 {2dc 2ch 2dc}@sp 10dc ss@top # last repeat ends at the beginning ch 3, so 10 dc
